sentences.text: Engine compartment fires are the most dangerous on small boats.
Shut down the engines, generator and blowers, and close the fuel valves.
Close vents and hatches to starve the fire of oxygen, and don’t open the engine hatch, since a rush of fresh air can make it flare violently.
Discharge the fixed extinguishing system if it hasn’t fired automatically.
Many systems shut down the engines when they discharge.
Then wait at least fifteen minutes for the compartment to cool before opening it, so the fire doesn’t reignite, and have a portable extinguisher ready when you do.
